evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Maintain availability and actual completion of the packaged Copilot CLI dynamic workflow and its one native subagent.
intent.acceptance: Independent protected runtime evidence binds the immutable packaged extension to the named invocation, completed lifecycle and one correlated completed smoke-marker subagent; full acceptance additionally binds the exact five-field durable result to that invocation.

evidence.opportunity: Every initial execution attempt of the named workflow, including reusable calls selected by immutable caller configuration and native child-job identity; reruns are not new opportunities.
filters: All potential reusable caller runs remain inventoried when actual branch selection cannot be reconstructed.
Agent-written results, editable issues, logs, fixture echoes and successful jobs alone do not establish native invocation.
Only an independent protected runtime receipt bound to the exact package/source profile establishes execution.
A completed native invocation is a partial outcome; the exact durable fixture result is a separate acceptance dimension.
No reconstructable independent pre-adoption execution evidence exists for this newly packaged fixture; this is not an invented zero baseline.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked exhaustive frozen direct/caller Actions inventories, initial-attempt job receipts, artifact and log availability, immutable source/import/package closure and source history. Acquisition never executes fetched code.
evidence.missingEvidenceRule: Unknown selection, missing protected provenance or missing exact result remains null, never an inferred failure or zero.

model.architecture: Native execution and fixture acceptance are separate deterministic predicates; only independent source-bound runtime receipts can establish them.
model.recommendation: Not measured until protected execution provenance is available; no keep bar or costs were established.

metrics.name: Exact durable-result acceptance
metrics.formula: Count verified invocations whose correlated durable result equals all five exact source-defined fields.
